text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This race will serve as the crucial preliminary contest before the spring Tenno Sho. And yet, Tamamo Cross seems antsy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She can't take her mind off Oguri Cap, who has dominated several graded races during her time as a classic-year racer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I give Tamamo Cross a pep talk to get her focused, and she departs for the race fully engaged for what's ahead.
